description: ksge P2 + P3 + P4 (proven patterns to promote to substrate convention). P2: REVISE->delta-re-audit — reviser writes a top-of-file 'Changes from rev1' delta-log; re-auditor audits against it (materially shorter delta read). P3: read consumed upstream SHA LIVE at build time (execSync in vite.config, baked into bundle + asserted by a probe) so provenance can't drift from the actual consumed commit. P4: pre-build gate (design -> audit -> HARD STOP before build) earned its cost — caught both Phase-1 blockers as cheap design-text fixes, no rebuild. Detail: stoa--q3l body + artifact.
title: Canonize 3 proven ksge patterns: REVISE-delta-re-audit, live-SHA-at-build, pre-build HARD-STOP gate
